privacyPage.lead: This policy explains how WATAD Software («WATAD», «we») collects, uses, stores, and protects personal data when you visit watadiq.com or work with us as a client.

intro.title: Introduction
paragraphs: We respect your privacy and aim to be transparent about the data we process. This policy applies to watadiq.com and related products operated by WATAD Software.
By using our website or services, you acknowledge this policy. Where consent is required (for example non-essential cookies), we ask before enabling those features.

controller.title: Data controller
paragraphs: WATAD Software is the data controller for personal data described in this policy.
Contact: info@watadiq.com Website: https://www.watadiq.com

collect.title: Information we collect
bullets: Usage data: pages visited, browser type, IP address (truncated where possible), referral URLs.
Communication data: messages you send via contact forms or email.
Cookie preferences: your cookie consent choices stored locally on your device.

cookies.title: Cookies & similar technologies
cookies.lead: We use cookies and local storage to run the site, remember language, and, only with your permission, analytics or marketing tools.
paragraphs: Essential cookies are always active because the site cannot function without them. You control optional categories from the cookie banner or the button at the bottom of this page.

legal.title: Legal bases for processing
bullets: Contract: delivering projects, accounts, and services you request.
Legitimate interests: securing our platform, preventing abuse, improving products.
Consent: non-essential cookies, optional marketing communications.
Legal obligation: responding to lawful requests when required.

use.title: How we use your information
bullets: Provide and maintain watadiq.com.
Respond to inquiries and support requests.
Analyze aggregated usage to improve performance (with consent where required).
Comply with law and enforce our terms.

sharing.title: Sharing & processors
paragraphs: We do not sell personal data. We share data only with trusted processors who help us operate the service (hosting, email delivery, security/CDN), under contracts that require appropriate safeguards.

retention.title: Data retention
bullets: Communication records: retained as needed to respond to inquiries.
Cookie consent: stored locally until you clear browser storage or change preferences.

security.title: Security
paragraphs: We use HTTPS/TLS, rate limiting, and infrastructure protections (WAF/CDN). No method is 100% secure; we continuously improve our controls.

rights.title: Your rights
bullets: Access, correction, or deletion of your personal data where applicable.
Withdraw consent for optional cookies or marketing.
Object to or restrict certain processing under applicable law.
Lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority in your country.
rights.note: To exercise rights, email info@watadiq.com. We may need to verify your identity.

children.title: Children
paragraphs: Our services are not directed at children under 16. We do not knowingly collect data from children. Contact us if you believe a child provided personal data.

changes.title: Changes to this policy
paragraphs: We may update this policy when our practices or legal requirements change. We will post the new version on this page with an updated date. Significant changes may be announced on the website.

intro.title: Agreement to terms
paragraphs: These Terms of Service («Terms») govern your access to watadiq.com and your use of products, websites, and professional services provided by WATAD Software («WATAD», «we», «us»).
By visiting our website, submitting an inquiry, or entering into a project agreement with us, you agree to these Terms. If you do not agree, please do not use our website or services.
Where a signed statement of work, proposal, or contract conflicts with these Terms, the signed agreement prevails for that specific project.

services.title: Our services
services.lead: WATAD provides digital agency services including, but not limited to:
bullets: Web design and development
Mobile application development
UI/UX design
Cybersecurity reviews and audits
Hosting, maintenance, and related technical support
paragraphs: Service scope, timelines, deliverables, and fees are defined in your proposal, invoice, or signed agreement. We may update service descriptions on our website without affecting active contracts.

eligibility.title: Eligibility & accounts
bullets: You must be at least 18 years old, or have legal authority to act on behalf of a business or organization.
You agree to provide accurate contact and billing information.
You are responsible for safeguarding credentials, API keys, and access you share with us.
You may not use our services for unlawful, harmful, or abusive purposes.

projects.title: Projects & deliverables
bullets: Timelines depend on agreed scope, timely feedback, and content or assets you provide.
Change requests outside the original scope may require a revised quote or timeline.
We may use subcontractors or trusted partners under confidentiality obligations.
You are responsible for reviewing deliverables and providing approval or feedback within agreed review windows.
projects.note: Delays caused by missing content, third-party approvals, or late client feedback may extend delivery dates without penalty to WATAD.

payment.title: Fees & payment
bullets: Prices are quoted in Iraqi Dinar (IQD) unless otherwise stated in writing.
Payment methods may include bank transfer, Zain Cash, or other methods we publish on our pricing page.
Unless agreed otherwise, work may pause if invoices or milestone payments are overdue.
Deposits and milestone payments are generally non-refundable once work has started, except where required by law or explicitly stated in your agreement.
paragraphs: Taxes, domain registration, third-party licenses, ad spend, and external service fees are excluded unless explicitly included in your quote.

ip.title: Intellectual property
bullets: Upon full payment, you receive the rights agreed in your project contract to the final deliverables created specifically for you.
WATAD retains ownership of pre-existing tools, frameworks, templates, internal libraries, and general know-how used to deliver the project.
We may display completed work in our portfolio, case studies, and marketing unless you request otherwise in writing before launch.
You warrant that materials you supply (logos, text, images, trademarks) do not infringe third-party rights.

client.title: Your responsibilities
bullets: Provide timely feedback, approvals, and required content.
Ensure you have rights to all brand assets, copy, and media you supply.
Maintain backups of your live systems when we are not contracted for ongoing hosting or maintenance.
Comply with applicable laws, including data protection rules for your end users.

confidentiality.title: Confidentiality
paragraphs: Each party agrees to protect non-public business, technical, and financial information shared during a project, except where disclosure is required by law or already public without breach.
We treat client project details as confidential and do not disclose them to third parties except as needed to deliver the service or as you authorize.

warranties.title: Warranties & disclaimers
paragraphs: We deliver services with professional skill and care consistent with industry standards for digital agencies.

Except as expressly stated in a signed agreement, our website and services are provided «as is» and «as available» without warranties of uninterrupted availability, error-free operation, or fitness for a particular purpose.
We do not guarantee specific business results such as revenue, rankings, conversions, or traffic.

liability.title: Limitation of liability
paragraphs: To the fullest extent permitted by applicable law, WATAD is not liable for indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or punitive damages, including lost profits, data loss, or business interruption.

Our total liability for any claim relating to a project or these Terms is limited to the fees you paid to WATAD for that project in the twelve (12) months before the event giving rise to the claim, unless a higher limit is stated in a signed agreement.
liability.note: Nothing in these Terms limits liability that cannot be limited under applicable law, including fraud or willful misconduct.

suspension.title: Suspension & termination
bullets: We may suspend access or terminate services if you breach these Terms, fail to pay, or misuse our systems.
You may terminate a project according to the cancellation terms in your signed agreement.
Upon termination, you remain responsible for fees for work completed and non-cancellable third-party costs.
Sections that by nature should survive termination, including payment, intellectual property, confidentiality, and liability limits, will continue to apply.

governing.title: Governing law & disputes
paragraphs: These Terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of Iraq, without regard to conflict-of-law principles.

The parties will first attempt to resolve disputes in good faith through direct communication. If unresolved, disputes shall be subject to the competent courts in Iraq, unless otherwise agreed in writing.

changes.title: Changes to these terms
paragraphs: We may update these Terms when our services, legal requirements, or business practices change. The updated version will be posted on this page with a revised date.

Continued use of the website after changes become effective constitutes acceptance of the updated Terms. Material changes to active client contracts will be handled through your project agreement where required.

about.title: About WATAD
about.intro: WATAD is an official Iraqi software agency specializing in web development, mobile applications, cybersecurity, and digital products that help bold brands grow.

sections.title: Our story
paragraphs: WATAD was founded to give Iraqi businesses and creators the same caliber of digital craftsmanship found in global tech hubs. We combine sharp design, reliable engineering, and security first thinking so every product we ship feels premium and performs under pressure.
From startups launching their first app to established brands refreshing their web presence, we partner closely with clients, translating ambitious ideas into shipped software.

sections.title: Mission
paragraphs: Enable generations of Iraqi entrepreneurs, artists, and organizations to achieve success, impact culture, and shape a better digital future, one product at a time.
list: Build fast, accessible, and beautiful digital experiences.
Protect what matters with modern cybersecurity practices.
Stay close to clients from strategy through launch and beyond.

securityPage.title: Security built in, not bolted on
securityPage.lead: WATAD Software delivers audits, penetration testing, and secure architecture for websites and apps, aligned with OWASP practices and built for Iraqi businesses.
securityPage.heroImageAlt: Cartoon security specialist holding a shield, WATAD cybersecurity illustration
securityPage.pillarsLead: From code review to production monitoring, we protect the full stack your customers trust.

pillars.title: Audits & penetration testing
pillars.text: We test like attackers do, before real attackers can. Manual and automated reviews across your web app, API, and admin surfaces.
bullets: OWASP Top 10 checklist
Authentication & session review
Written findings with severity levels
Remediation guidance for your team

pillars.title: Secure architecture
pillars.text: Security decisions made at design time cost less than fixes after launch. We design roles, secrets, and data flows correctly from day one.
bullets: Least-privilege access models
Encrypted data in transit & at rest
Backup & recovery planning
Cloud and hosting hardening

pillars.title: Monitoring & response
pillars.text: Launch is not the finish line. We help you watch traffic, logs, and alerts so issues are caught early.
bullets: Uptime & error monitoring setup
Security header configuration
Incident response playbook
Optional ongoing retainer

securityPage.processLead: A clear, repeatable workflow, no black boxes.

process.title: Scope
process.text: Define assets, threats, and compliance needs with your team.

process.title: Assess
process.text: Run automated scans and manual tests on staging or production.

process.title: Report
process.text: Deliver prioritized findings, evidence, and fix recommendations.

process.title: Harden
process.text: Support fixes, re-test critical items, and sign off before launch.

securityPage.standardsLead: We work with the same tools and standards trusted by global security teams.
securityPage.deliverablesLead: Concrete outputs you can share with stakeholders, not vague promises.
securityPage.ctaText: Tell us about your website or app. We will recommend the right audit depth and timeline.
